body: ADDITIONAL API-COMPATIBILITY DISCLOSURE for leaf candidate 735162d: converting public NodeSummary from case class to private-constructor non-case class intentionally removes Product, generated Mirror/fromProduct, and generated unapply/pattern-match compatibility. The candidate has compile-time courts for Product/Mirror/fromProduct/constructor and preserves explicit public reads/apply/copy, but my first handoff did not name the unapply/pattern-match loss. ImportanceWeight is also new public vocabulary; I treated the chief ruling on this bead as the explicit authorization required by governance. Please include both consequences in review and decide whether an ADR/docs line is required before landing. I am not claiming source compatibility.
